objective: Test whether each frozen C0 word-role association depends on the real source-word/structural-position alignment rather than regional word frequencies and generic role prevalence.

null_operator.name: WITHIN_REGION_ROLE_ELIGIBLE_WORD_IDENTITY_SHUFFLE
null_operator.description: For each role separately, shuffle opaque source-word identities across all role-eligible lexical observations within each region while leaving document/row position, numeric structure, role-match flags, region sizes, and the region-specific word-frequency multiset unchanged.

candidate_gate.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg across exactly eight frozen candidates

claim_semantics.pass: candidate-specific word/role association is stronger than region-frequency-preserving structure-destroying null
claim_semantics.fail: candidate does not establish structure dependence under this null

allowed: structure-dependent survival or failure of a frozen positional/template candidate
